faqs.a: Permits that do not require a plan review (Roofing, Residential Plumbing, Electrical and Mechanical) are typically issued within one business day of a completed application submission. Major projects like New Single Family and Commercial require a plan review and can take 4 to 6 weeks to complete the first plan review.
